systems.owner: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation, launched 30 September 2025 with the Ministère de la Décentralisation et de la Gouvernance Locale; extension under the programme PRSCG 2
systems.tiers: pilot in three communes, Porto-Novo, Lokossa and Djougou, with five administrative requests and their payment online; to be extended in stages to the other communes

note: The ministry describes e-Communes as five requests residents make and pay for online in three pilot communes, which is an online service to residents; it states nothing about the connection of the mairies that answer them.
